Is anything random? Sponsored by Hostinger. Go to https://hostinger.com/veritasium and use code VERITASIUM for an additional 10% off.

For more on Bell tests, watch our video - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NIk_0AW5hFU

You can also check out Matthew Bolan’s video on the maths behind his Minecraft exploit here -  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5Icj5TNmBUI

To see the random numbers produced by the quantum experiment in this video, go to https://ve42.co/CURBy

Last year, we launched Elements of Truth on Kickstarter. We’re now in the final stages of production, and Kickstarter rewards are shipping soon. If you missed the campaign, you can now pre-order the retail edition through our new website here - https://ve42.co/YTDEcl  
If you backed us on Kickstarter, don’t worry, your game will ship before any pre-orders are fulfilled.

If you’re looking for a molecular modelling kit, try Snatoms, a kit I invented where the atoms snap together magnetically - https://ve42.co/SnatomsV 

Sign up for the Veritasium newsletter for weekly science updates - https://ve42.co/Newsletter

Join our Patreon for early access to work-in-progress videos and behind-the-scenes extras https://ve42.co/VePatreon 

3D graph made with Desmos (https://www.desmos.com), licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 - https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/

Not an official Minecraft video. Not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.

▀▀▀
00:00 The Slot Machine Hack That Was Stumping Casinos
01:49 Solitaire and Nuclear Fission
05:43 The Monte Carlo Method 
10:04 Finding Minecraft Diamonds With Math 
13:38 Linear Congruential Generators
15:39 Why Java's Random Numbers Are Predictable
19:58 How Russian Hackers Cracked the Mersenne Twister 
23:27 Cryptographic RNGs and Cloudflare's Lava Lamps 
27:33 Quantum Entanglement and True Randomness 
32:05 Using Quasars to Choose Quantum Measurements

▀▀▀
Special thanks to the experts and collaborators who made this video possible:
Krister Shalm, for so generously sharing his time and expertise throughout the making of this video, and for all his help in explaining the science behind the quantum random number generator.  Our thanks also goes to Rebecca Jacobson and the rest of the NIST team for showing us their random number generator and reviewing our explanation of it.
David Kaiser, for his invaluable guidance on the physics of Bell tests, and for generously giving his time to help us get the science right.
Matthew Bolan for showing us his Minecraft exploit and reviewing the mathematics behind our explanation 
Brian Hayes for his expertise on the history of random number generation and his guidance on the script
Makoto Matsumoto, co-creator of the Mersenne Twister, for explaining how it works and sharing some wonderful stories about its creation.
Darrin Hoke and Brendan Koerner for sharing their knowledge and helping us piece together the casino story.
Statistics Crystallized, whose excellent video inspired our Mersenne Twister animation - https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCUOHBAq4ZYRh9BWQelSt7jg

▀▀▀
References: https://ve42.co/RNGRefs
